name: circlesong
description: CircleSong — Theory-guided guitar workstation in the browser: compose on the Circle of Fifths, hear it on a physically modelled guitar, sequence loops into songs, and tune your instrument.

scripts.android:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
